name: antigravity-account-switcher
description: Visual multi-account switcher and profile manager embedded directly in Antigravity IDE, synchronized across Antigravity 2.0 Desktop and the CLI.

scripts.test: node tests/test_token_manager.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

enumDescriptions: Prefer the Antigravity IDE/Desktop standalone token when stores disagree.
Prefer the Antigravity CLI token when stores disagree.
antigravityAccountSwitcher.preferredStor.description: Which token store wins when more than one account is present. Conflicts are always reported instead of switching automatically.

antigravityAccountSwitcher.pollIntervalM.description: How often to poll token files for changes. Polling is required because file watch events are unreliable on /mnt/c (WSL).
